title: Disappointed
text: Disappointed. Very noisy. I have cats and dogs. It picks up hair from pets on the floor nicely but then you have to pull the hair off the vacuum filter - yucky.  Not powerful enough to pick up the small sized cat or dog kibbles on the floor.

product_metadata.title: EUREKA Lightweight Corded Stick Cleaner Powerful Suction Convenient Handheld Vac with Filter for Hard Floor, 3-in-1 Vacuum, Purple
features: Detachable Motorized Floor Nozzle: Eureka NES310 comes with the motorized brushroll, which helps loosen up particles and dust on multi-surfaces..350.0 watts
Powerful pick up: Nonstop suction power picks up particles like dust and pollen, while the washable filtration system captures the debris.
Easily Converts to Handvac: For convenient above floor cleaning, reaching tight spaces, stairs and even car interiors. Remove the nozzle and you have a handvac with or without the long stick.
Built-in Versatile Tools : No more concern about looking for the attachments here and there. The built-in crevice tool and dusting brush are extremely convenient for quick clean-up for small places.
Lightweight & Easy to Maneuver: At only 4 lbs. Swivel steering provides excellent control and makes it easy to maneuver around and reach under furniture.
description: We know you value a clean home and Eureka is proud to offer whole home cleaning solutions to make life a little easier.

Eureka Upgraded Blaze 3-in-1 Lightweight Corded Stick Vacuum your new go-to for all your cleaning needs! With powerful suction power, lightweight design and advanced swivel steering, you can effortlessly navigate around hardwood floors, furniture, stairs, car interiors, and ceilings!

Our portable vacuum cleaner for home boasts a motorized brush roll that captures even the tiniest specks of dust and dirt, leaving your home spotless. And its large and washable dust cup and filter means longer cleaning time.

This handheld vacuum also features multiple built-in accessories for cleaning tight corners and narrow crevices, while its free-standing feature allows rest when cleaning. Whether you're a busy professional living in an apartment or a homeowner looking for essential cleaning tools, our mini vacuum is your perfect solution!
If you have any questions, contact our customer service team at 1-800-282-2886.
Warning: When using the vacuum cleaner, the floor brush may be clogged by hairs and dirt. We recommend cleaning the roller brush and the belt every 2 weeks.
Long-term failure to clean may cause malfunction, or even risk of smoke and belt broken.
